designing an architecture for massively multiplayer games that is capable of providing a consistent and responsive game experience to the players.

we have developed a dynamic load management scheme for MMO games that can handle the transient nature of the load and can provide better quality of service for the players.
we have implemented an architecture for massively multiplayer games that is able to handle large numbers of players and to adapt to transient crowding.

locality aware dynamic load management can be used to achieve a finer grain partition of a game world and to reduce the average response time of users.
